title: Compat API v1.48: implement POST /build/prune
body:
### Feature request description

Docker API v1.48 clients can clear build cache through `POST /build/prune`, but Podman's compat API doesn't register that endpoint, so calls like `docker builder prune` fail against Podman. This adds the endpoint with support for `reserved-space` (renamed from `keep-storage`), `max-used-space`, and `min-free-space`, so Docker clients can limit how much cache is kept or removed.

Related to podman-container-tools/buildah#7216.

Part of #30161, parent #30159.
